attachments.text:
The `s:Buffer.create()` will fire some of the autocmd like `FileType` `BufEnter` etc... due to `bufload` calls.

1. The `bufload` is needed to call `setbufline` before showing the buffer.
2. Basically, `FileType` autocmd is needs for syntax highlighting.

So in `vsim-vital-vs` context, `s:Buffer.create()` should fire autocmd but in this case we don't need `FileType` autocmd because syntax highlighting will be applied by calling `s:Markdown.apply`.

So we can avoid autocmd here.

attachments.text:
The `s:Buffer.create()` will fire some of the autocmd like `FileType` `BufEnter` etc... due to `bufload` calls.

1. The `bufload` is needed to call `setbufline` before showing the buffer.
2. Basically, `FileType` autocmd is needs for syntax highlighting.

So in `vsim-vital-vs` context, `s:Buffer.create()` should fire autocmd but in this case we don't need `FileType` autocmd because syntax highlighting will be applied by calling `s:Markdown.apply`.

So we can avoid autocmd here.

*Summary*

This plugin does not complete the import statement or expand the snippet in vim-vsnip as it does in <https://github.com/lighttiger2505/deoplete-vim-lsp|deoplete-vim-lsp>.  
However, it may work only once right after the activation of Vim/neovim, as shown in the following video.

*Environment*

OS : macOS Big Sur 11.6  
neovim version : v0.5.0  
denoos.vim version : <https://github.com/vim-denops/denops.vim/commit/a8f984a2ef589c376ca3c30f98203a15c8fb57a7|vim-denops/denops.vim@a8f984a>  
ddc.vim : <https://github.com/Shougo/ddc.vim/commit/de4c2a9f7a0895fc0a7b33be72e6fa329b25d34a|Shougo/ddc.vim@de4c2a9>  
ddc-vim-lsp version: <https://github.com/shun/ddc-vim-lsp/commit/c47c98e778e9b2ad018a5f55dcacbd695adde2b1|c47c98e>

*minimal vimrc*

```
set encoding=utf-8
scriptencoding utf-8
set nocp

let g:loaded_getscript = 1
let g:loaded_getscriptPlugin = 1
let g:loaded_logiPat = 1
let g:loaded_spellfile_plugin = 1
let g:loaded_rrhelper = 1
let g:loaded_vimball = 1
let g:loaded_vimballPlugin = 1

if has('vim_starting')
    set runtimepath+=~/.cache/dein/repos/github.com/Shougo/dein.vim
endif

if dein#load_state('~/.cache/dein/')
    call dein#begin('~/.cache/dein/')
    call dein#add('prabirshrestha/vim-lsp')
    call dein#add('mattn/vim-lsp-settings')
    call dein#add('vim-denops/denops.vim')
    call dein#add('Shougo/ddc.vim')
    call dein#add('shun/ddc-vim-lsp')
    call dein#add('matsui54/ddc-matcher_fuzzy')
    call dein#add('hrsh7th/vim-vsnip-integ')
    call dein#add('hrsh7th/vim-vsnip')
    call dein#end()
    call dein#save_state()
endif

if dein#check_install()
    call dein#install()
endif
"Reqired
filetype plugin indent on
syntax enable

set completeopt-=preview
set pumheight=10
set backspace=indent,eol,start

inoremap <silent><expr> <CR> pumvisible() ? "\<C-y>" : <CR>

"ddc.vim settings
call ddc#custom#patch_global('sourceOptions', {
    \ '_': {
    \   'ignoreCase': v:true,
    \   'matchers': ['matcher_fuzzy'],
    \ },
    \ 'vim-lsp': {
    \   'mark': 'lsp',
    \   'forceCompletionPattern': '\.\w*|:\w*|->\w*',
    \   'minAutoCompleteLength': 1
    \ },
    \ 'vsnip': {
    \   'mark': 'snip'
    \ },
    \ })

call ddc#custom#patch_filetype(
    \ ['c', 'cpp', 'go'], 'sources',
    \ ['vsnip', 'vim-lsp']
    \ )

inoremap <silent><expr> <TAB>
    \ pumvisible() ? "\<C-n>" :
    \ (col('.') <= 1 <Bar><Bar> getline('.')[col('.') - 2] =~# '\s') ?
    \ "\<TAB>" : ddc#manual_complete()

call ddc#enable()

let g:lsp_settings = {
            \ 'gopls': {
            \   'initialization_options': {'usePlaceholders': v:true},
            \ },
            \}
```
